title: Design system overhaul, production hardening, and GUI release
highlights: Complete design system overhaul: light-first glass morphism, Electric Violet accent, motion system, and accessibility improvements across all 36 panels and 117 components.
Production-hardened GUI: devtools disabled, CSP tightened, RemoteDev stub hidden, consistent versioning across TUI and GUI.
New workspace packages: @ideocode/types, @ideocode/automations, @ideocode/enterprise-mcp-client, @ideocode/mcp-apps with typed contracts.
improvements: 215 aria-labels and semantic roles across 64 files for WCAG-compliant accessibility.
Manual Vite code splitting for Monaco, Mermaid, KaTeX, xterm, and Cytoscape vendor bundles.
Clean TypeScript typecheck across 5 workspace packages with zero errors.
All 64 tests passing across 15 test files.
Consistent v1.2.0 versioning across TUI binary, Tauri GUI, and all workspace packages.
fixes: Resolved all TypeScript compilation errors in workspace packages.
Removed accidentally committed node_modules symlinks and added proper .gitignore.
Fixed CSP to scope connect-src to known API endpoints only.
Removed stale package-lock.json in favor of pnpm workspace.
Fixed version fallback in App.tsx to match release version.
